Chinese inventory counters combine broad item coverage, history and export. Focus the first image on skewers rather than implying broad model coverage.
Manual correction is familiar adjacent-category language. The second screenshot should make the actual add/remove controls easy to see.

localizationNotes: Use actual English app UI for en-US assets and actual Simplified Chinese app UI for zh-Hans assets.
Do not translate UI pixels in marketing images. Capture each locale after final app localization.
Keep language concise; do not imply a billing system when the app only counts and stores results.
optionalFutureExperiments: After release, compare photo-result versus manual-correction hero screenshots using App Store product page optimization.

sources.title: Creating your product page

sources.title: App Store search
sources.supports: Text relevance includes title, subtitle, keywords and primary category; user behavior also contributes.

sources.title: Platform version information

sources.title: Keywords best practices

sources.title: Custom product pages
